verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const rd=(p)=>{if(!fs.existsSync(p)){console.error("indeterminate: missing "+p);process.exit(79)}return fs.readFileSync(p,"utf8")};const s=rd("lib/staff.ts");const files=["app/(main)/admin/marketing/layout.tsx","app/(main)/admin/marketing/agent/actions.ts","app/(main)/admin/marketing/automations/actions.ts","app/(main)/admin/marketing/deliverability/actions.ts"];const bad=[];if(/staffCan\(member\.role,\s*domain,\s*level\)/.test(s)||!/getCapabilityOverrides/.test(s))bad.push("requireStaffCap calls staffCan without the capability overrides");for(const f of files){const t=rd(f);if(/staffCan\(staff\.role,\s*.marketing.(,\s*.read.)?\)/.test(t)&&!/getCapabilityOverrides|staffCanNow/.test(t))bad.push(f+" gates on code defaults only")}if(bad.length){console.error("SCAN-757: "+bad.join("; ")+", so the roles grid cannot revoke or grant what those doors allow.");process.exit(1)}'

append.detail: requireStaffCap in lib/staff.ts called staffCan(role, domain, level) with no overrides, so the capability_permissions grid a janitor edits on /admin/roles was ignored by about thirty capability gates, and the four marketing doors (layout, agent, automations, deliverability actions) called staffCan on the role alone the same way; a grid denial did not close them and a grant did not open them while requireAdmin honoured the grid. lib/staff.ts now imports getCapabilityOverrides, requireStaffCap loads it (request-cached, fails open to the code defaults) and passes it as staffCan's fourth argument, and a new exported staffCanNow(domain, level) pairs getStaffMember with staffCan plus the grid; the four marketing files use it. Pinned by lib/staff.test.ts: a marketer row set to none on marketing makes requireStaffCap redirect and staffCanNow false, a support row set to write opens both, an empty grid resolves as the code defaults, a throwing grid read fails open, and a non-staff or view-as viewer is denied before the grid is read.
